newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU to probe Alitalia capital increase - EU sources.
newsitem.headline: EU to probe Alitalia capital increase - EU sources.

text.p: The European Commission is expected to decide on Wednesday to open a state aid probe into a rescue plan for troubled Italian carrier Alitalia, European Union sources said on Tuesday.
"(The Commission) is uncertain whether state aid is involved or not," one source said. "We need more information."
The plan for a 1.5 trillion lire capital increase for the struggling carrier was approved by industrial state industrial holding company IRI, Alitalia's majority shareholder, in July.
Alitalia has said it is a question of a capital injection that any investor would do, and that the plan does not involve state aid, which the Commission only approves under special circumstances.
Last week, rival airline British Airways said it would complain to the European Commission over what it regards as unfair state aid to Alitalia.

Another EU source suggested that a Commission decision to look into the Alitalia plan would be no big surprise as the EU executive usually opens state aid investigations into major restructuring cases involving airlines.
In the end, the Commission has approved all previous cases, but only with conditions.
